description: This file defines the AccountRepository interface which extends Spring Data's CrudRepository. It provides an abstraction for CRUD operations and a custom method to find an account by account number.

classes.name: AccountRepository
classes.description: An interface extending CrudRepository for performing CRUD operations on Account entities, with an additional custom method to find accounts by account number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Custom query method to find an Account by its account number, returning an Optional<Account>.
